caption: The drawing depicts a weathervane with ornate detailing. At the top, there is a decorative gold arrow with leaf-like ends, and a banner reading "COURT HOUSE" in capital gold letters with a brown outline. The main vertical pole is dark in color and features intricate black scrollwork in the center, supporting gold directional letters "W" and "S" (appearing prominently on the left and right, respectively, with parts of "N" and "E" somewhat obscured), indicating cardinal directions. At the base of the central structure, there is a large metallic greenish-gray sphere resting on a small conical support. The entire weathervane is presented within a rectangular boundary at the center of a larger, off-white or cream-colored background. In the bottom right corner, there is a smaller, simplified schematic drawing of the weathervane, including directional arrows and a measurement indicating a height of 12 feet. The artist's signature "A. Merton Del." appears at the lower left outside the main border.
title: Weather Vane
